name: gateway-signal
description: Outbound-only Signal gateway via signal-cli-rest-api. send POSTs a text message via the local signal-cli-rest-api server.

credentials.name: signal_base_url
credentials.description: signal-cli-rest-api base URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (env override: COS_SIGNAL_BASE_URL)

credentials.name: signal_number
credentials.description: Linked Signal account phone in E.164 (env override: COS_SIGNAL_NUMBER)
